notes.title: Game Update 4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29914088/c08216243b32c25ab848f7bfcec89712900d9911.png[/img]

Hello!

We just released an update to the game. It's not super meaty, but it contains an important feature that'll help me pinpoint bugs going forward. If you encounter a problem in the game, you can now hit SHIFT + S to copy the state of the game to the clipboard. If you paste the resulting text dump in your bug rapport, I can recreate the exact conditions of the bug. Pretty nifty, eh?

Keep reporting if you see anything problematic. Our goal is to try to stay on top of any issue, big or small.

Here's a rundown of what's been updated:

• Game: Added game state dump feature (SHIFT + S)
• Game: Tweaked GUI
• Gateway 1: Tweaked drag targets for the pearls puzzle
• Gateway 1: Fixed issue with the pearl room

I hope this update solves some of the problems you've been having. Keep reporting if you run into issues.

Cheers,

- a

tags.feature: • Game: Added game state dump feature (SHIFT + S)

tags.bug: • Gateway 1: Fixed issue with the pearl room

notes.title: Game Update 3 - German language support added!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29914088/498cb2f13e180d4a03673d1bc697a8c0f3cc3af3.png[/img]

Fellow Travelers!

In our ongoing effort to improve the game, we've added German language support! Rejoice!

We've also monitored your feedback and addressed the reported issues. Keep reporting if you see anything problematic. Our goal is to try to stay on top of any issue, big or small.

Here's a rundown of what this updated contains:

• Game: Added German language support
• Game: Prevented players from naming save files using reserved words
• Game: Added mouse-over sounds to all in-game close-up buttons
• Gateway 1: Addressed leave close-up issue by the television
• Gateway 2: Added achievement fail-safe points
• Gateway 2: Prevented the player from interrupting critical animations
• Gateway 2: Prevented player from interrupting video transfer prematurely
• Gateway 2 & 3: Fixed translation issues
• Gateway 3: Tweaked heartbeat puzzle
• Gateway 3: Fixed minor presentation bug in the heartbeat puzzle
• Gateway 3: Extended some clickable surfaces

I hope this update solves some of the problems you've been having. Keep reporting if you run into issues.

Cheers,

- a

notes.title: Soundtrack released & Czech language added
notes.content:

notes.content:

Hello!

I just wanted to drop you a line about achievements. We have them. You gotta collect them all. Obviously.

I also wanted to thank the sweet people in the The Dream Machine forum, who kept asking us to implement achievements and to Essen, who helped us make it all happen!

I hope this piece of good news tides you over as you're waiting for us to finally announce a release date for the game. Stay tuned. Not much longer now...

Cheers,

As a few of you have noticed, we've added a soundtrack to the game page. So yes, The Gateway Trilogy will come with an optional soundtrack for all you lovers of haunting ambient soundscapes out there.

If you're interested, you can wishlist using the link below.

Please note that the exact contents of the soundtrack is still being tweaked. Expect more tracks to be added soon.

Cheers,
